title: native egl wrap drops recordable attribs

commit.merge_subject: merge: native egl wrap drops recordable attribs

description:
The third and last eglCreateWindowSurface site that passed
EGL_RECORDABLE_ANDROID in the SURFACE attrib list: the M5 native
encoder wrap in DevelopSession::Impl::runSurfaceJob (the
setEncoderSurface attach path).

EGL_ANDROID_recordable defines the flag only for the
eglChooseConfig/eglGetConfigAttrib attribute lists; passing it to
eglCreateWindowSurface is invalid, and the Xiaomi 15 Ultra's EGL
rejects the call with EGL_NO_SURFACE (EGL_BAD_ATTRIBUTE) — the same
device-observed failure the writer's two Kotlin sites had. The
recordable requirement rides the CONFIG this session opened at init
(egl.open windowCapable=true recordable=true, GlesPipeline.cpp:185
keeps EGL_RECORDABLE_ANDROID in the config attribs where the spec
allows it), so the wrap now passes null surface attribs — the form
GlesPreviewSession.cpp:753 proves on this device, and the form the
writer's landed fix uses.
